headings.text: Arrive Like Royalty. Celebrate Like Stars.
When should we book our prom limo?
Can parents request a specific pickup or drop-off order?
What is your policy on alcohol and substance use?
Lock In Your Prom Night Ride

paragraphs: Prom is one of the most memorable nights of high school. Make it absolutely unforgettable with Deluxe Limousine Service. Our stretch limousines, Hummer limos, and luxury party buses give your group a safe, stylish, and Instagram-worthy entrance. We handle every pickup, photo stop, and drop-off so you and your friends can focus on having the time of your lives.

Every chauffeur is fully licensed, background-checked, and trained in defensive driving. Parents get peace of mind with our strict no-substance policy and real-time dispatch tracking from pickup to final drop-off.

Bluetooth-connected premium audio, color-changing LED ceilings, and mirror bars turn the limo into a rolling dance party. Bring your own playlist or use ours — the vibe is set the moment the door opens.
Dinner, the dance, after-party, and every scenic photo spot in between — we plan a custom route with you so the whole group stays together, on time, and looking sharp all night long.

Perfect for couples and small groups of up to 10 passengers. Tinted privacy windows keep your group exclusive while the LED-lit interior sets the mood. Complimentary sparkling cider, ice, and bottled water come standard so the celebration starts the moment you step inside.

For groups of 14 to 40, our Hummer stretch limos and luxury party buses are the ultimate prom statement. Wrap-around leather seating, flat-screen TVs, booming subwoofers, and strobe lighting transform the ride into the official pre-game of the night. Everyone rides together — no one gets left behind.

Prom season in Orange County is extremely competitive — most schools hold prom in April and May. We recommend booking 2 to 4 months in advance to lock in your top vehicle choice. Saturdays sell out first.

Yes. We work directly with parents and group organizers to design a custom route — usually 3 to 5 stops for photos, dinner, the dance venue, and any after-party location. You'll receive a written itinerary 48 hours before the event.

Zero tolerance. All passengers must be 21+ to consume alcohol, and any sign of underage drinking or substance use results in immediate termination of the ride with no refund. Our chauffeurs are trained to enforce this rule respectfully but firmly.
Saturdays sell out fast. Get a quote, choose your vehicle, and reserve your date before someone else does. Sal and the DLS team make prom planning one less thing to worry about.
